name: Avishkar
description: Avishkar, formerly and also called Kaladesh (Kalad), is a plane of inspired invention whose life depends on aether and which is now united under the Avishkar Assembly.

bio.text: Avishkar is the renamed plane of Kaladesh, the home plane of the Nalaars and the Varmas, where the Aetherdrift race ends.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

bio.text: Its profile says the Consulate was overthrown in a popular, nearly bloodless revolution and Kaladesh was reborn as Avishkar, which is then united under the new Avishkar Assembly, planning to resurrect the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

timeline.summary: The Great Aether Boom begins as the Mending leaves massive quantities of raw aether available.
timeline.quote: Since the powers of the Planeswalkers were reduced, there were suddenly massive quantities of raw aether for the taking.

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "Great Aether Boom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venya Sangmi succeeds in creating a sol ring, displayed at the Inventors' Fair.
timeline.quote: They eventually succeeded in creating a sol ring.

citation.text: "Sol Ring", section "Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rashmi builds a Sol Ring to capture foreign sunlight after Nissa's question.
timeline.quote: Rashmi built a Sol Ring to capture such light to test whether it would.

citation.text: "Sol Ring", section "Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avishkari advance teams deploy and find the treaties secured with the Saurid Autocracy were not signed with the full knowledge of other inhabitants.
timeline.quote: Advance teams from Avishkar were deployed to Muraganda a year before the beginning of the race

citation.text: "Muraganda", section "Second Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Avishkar, Rashmi works on the Matter Transporter, and Saheeli eventually relents and helps complete it.
timeline.quote: However, Saheeli eventually relented and helped Rashmi complete the device.

citation.text: "Plane", section "The Planar Bridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Consulate seizes Rashmi and her invention at the Inventors' Fair.
timeline.quote: both inventor and invention were seized by the Consulate during their confiscation of submitted inventions

citation.text: "Plane", section "The Planar Bridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret has Rashmi expand the device into the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret had Rashmi expand the device into the Planar Bridge

citation.text: "Plane", section "The Planar Bridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret steals the Planar Portal by Bolas's order and builds it into his body.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret took it off the plane, and incorporated it in his body.

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Indigo Revolution removes the Consulate from power in a nearly bloodless revolution and installs the Avishkar Assembly.
timeline.quote: The Consulate was removed from power in a nearly bloodless revolution

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "The Indigo Revolution and Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Omenpaths open and the Assembly establishes embassies and holds the first Ghirapur Grand Prix, a chaotic race across nearly two dozen planes.
timeline.quote: a widely advertised event called the Ghirapur Grand Prix was held the year that the Omenpaths opened

citation.text: "Avishkar", section "The Indigo Revolution and Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Indigo Revolution removes the Consulate; the Avishkar Assembly is installed and renames the plane Avishkar.
timeline.quote: the Consulate was removed from power in the Indigo Revolution

citation.text: "Consulate", section "Rebuilding and the Indigo Revolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra wakes to Nissa reading in bed.
timeline.quote: Nissa. Her Nissa.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Nissa reveals Chandra talked in her sleep about bringing her back to Zendikar and seems crestfallen.
timeline.quote: You were telling someone how much it would mean to you to bring me back to Zendikar.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Nissa says she does not want Chandra to fix the problem for her.
timeline.quote: I don't want you to fix the problem for me.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia calls them to breakfast and teases Chandra as her turncoat daughter.
timeline.quote: Don't deprive me of one last breakfast with my turncoat daughter.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia laments that Chandra will not wear an Aether Ranger uniform.
timeline.quote: Of course, she won't be wearing an Aether Ranger uniform.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire emerges through an Omenpath onto Amonkhet to find the Speed Demons took first place and she is second.
timeline.quote: And Spitfire realizes it's not her.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Elspeth heals Chandra's injuries with concentrated light.
timeline.quote: Concentrated light illuminates Chandra's forehead, her back, her ribs

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Elspeth warns that a storm of primordial magic is leaving dragons on planes that never knew them.
timeline.quote: A raging storm of primordial magic has been flowing between worlds, leaving dragons in its wake.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Elspeth blesses Chandra and Nissa and vanishes in a flash.
timeline.quote: And many blessings on your relationship.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita reveals her father Mohar is in jail for attempting a coup.
timeline.quote: Considering he's in jail, I think he has worse things to worry about

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra hugs Sita and introduces Nissa.
timeline.quote: You really saved me and mom out there!

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra joins the reigning champions, the Cloudspire Racing Team, in the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: Chandra chose to join the reigning champions, the Cloudspire Racing Team

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace attacks the racers in Avishkar, rendering them unconscious and taking Loot back; Chandra is badly hurt.
timeline.quote: Jace rendered them unconscious, taking the child back.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Desparkening Daretti loses his spark and is stranded on Avishkar.
timeline.quote: In the Desparkening , Daretti lost his spark and was stranded on Avishkar .

citation.text: "Daretti", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daretti bankrolls the Goblin Rocketeers in the second Ghirapur Grand Prix hoping to find new interplanar travel.
timeline.quote: He bankrolled the team in the hopes of discovering a new means of interplanar travel after the loss of his spark.

citation.text: "Daretti", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daretti backs Chandra as she fights insurgents in Mohar Varma's attempted Consulate coup, which is prevented.
timeline.quote: Ultimately, the coup was prevented, although the Rocketeers did not place in the race.

citation.text: "Daretti", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Consulate spends great resources trying to shut down the race and imprison the NCC's leaders.
timeline.quote: The Consulate spent great resources attempting to shut down the race and imprison the NCC's leaders, and was successful for some years.

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Ghirapur Sprint". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the NCC becomes a major political party following the Indigo Revolution, the race is proposed as a tool of soft power.
timeline.quote: When the NCC became a major political party after Avishkar's Indigo Revolution , the race was proposed as a tool of soft power

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Ghirapur Sprint". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The chaotic inaugural Grand Prix, the first multiplanar race, crosses nearly two dozen planes; some teams are killed or lost, and Kylem's Cloudspire Racing Team wins.
timeline.quote: Kylem's team, the Cloudspire Racing Team , won this edition.

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Avishkar Assembly expands the event beyond Avishkar to invite teams from many planes as an annual festival.
timeline.quote: the Avishkar Assembly sought to expand the event beyond the borders of Ghirapur and Avishkar itself

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The second interplanar Grand Prix is held around 4564 AR across Amonkhet and Muraganda with the Aetherspark as grand prize.
timeline.quote: The Aetherspark , an artifact that contained a planeswalker's spark , was offered as the race's grand prize.

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ghirapur holds the first Ghirapur Grand Prix to showcase Avishkar.
timeline.quote: a widely advertised multiplanar racing event called the Ghirapur Grand Prix was held at least a year after the Omenpaths opened.

citation.text: "Omenpath", section "Avishkar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Valgavoth sends the Speed Demon and Winter to win the Ghirapur Grand Prix and gives Winter Loot.
timeline.quote: He sent the Speed Demon and Winter to win the race and bring the Aetherspark back to Duskmourn.

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Winter loses the race and Loot, Valgavoth conjures a door from Avishkar to Duskmourn and drags him back.
timeline.quote: Valgavoth conjured a door connecting Avishkar to Duskmourn, dragging the man back through it.

citation.text: "Valgavoth", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth defeats a dragon at the Ghirapur Grand Prix and heals Chandra.
timeline.quote: She then healed Chandra's wounds and informed her and Nissa that dragonstorms were moving through Omenpaths.

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Dragonstorms". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace meddles with Chandra's mind at the Ghirapur Grand Prix, leaving her a strange mental link to him.
timeline.quote: After Jace meddled with her mind during the Ghirapur Grand Prix, Chandra developed a strange mental link to him.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
